name: Language Tokens
description: Provides tokens for the current interface language (code, uppercase code, name).
project_description:
Back to top 

 Obsolete module 
 
 This module was a temporary fix for the missing language related tokens in the Token module. These are available in the token module since version 1.10 . See also Issue #2863200 .

 Back to top 

 Module no longer supported 
 
 Replace the tokens from this module by the tokens from the Token module:

 
 [current-language:name] => [language:name] : The current language name. 
 [current-language:code] => [language:langcode] : The current language code.
